chapter: Cal Massey, Coltrane and the Jazztet
title: Benny Golson and the Jazztet versus Coltrane
summary: Golson invited Tyner into what became the Jazztet, while Tyner had already told Coltrane he wanted to play with him.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: And you were in the Jazztet.

Yes, the Jazztet with Benny Golson, and Benny was from Philly too. He heard about me and we kind of connected and that was before him and Art Farmer formed the Jazztet. But I told Benny, I said listen, you know Miles called John back in the band and I told him I am supposed to do something with John. Benny asked me if I would play a little while in his band and I said, “OK, fine.” That became the history playing with John, developing in that context.
